en.headline: CityU says students in orientation-camp incident admitted fault; discipline imposed
en.dek: City University of Hong Kong said students involved in an orientation-camp incident have admitted their mistakes and that its disciplinary committee has imposed penalties; the organising society has been dissolved.
body: City University of Hong Kong said on Friday that students involved in an orientation-camp incident have admitted their faults and that its disciplinary committee has already imposed disciplinary measures.

The university earlier set up a disciplinary investigation committee after a video circulated showing inappropriate behaviour during a “Disco Night” segment of an orientation camp organised by a student society under the Department of Management Sciences on 27 August.

The organising society issued an apology and was later dissolved by the student union under existing mechanisms. The university reiterated a zero-tolerance stance on any form of inappropriate behaviour at orientation or campus activities and said it would continue to follow its established procedures.

zh.headline: 城大：迎新營涉事學生已承認過失 紀律委員會已作出處分
zh.dek: 城大表示，涉及迎新營事件的學生已承認過失，紀律委員會已作出紀律處分；主辦幹事會已被學生會解散。
body: 香港城市大學今日表示，涉及迎新營事件的學生已承認過失，校方紀律委員會已根據事件嚴重性作出紀律處分。
較早前社交平台流傳短片，顯示8月27日由管理科學學科聯會主辦的迎新營「Disco Night」環節出現不恰當行為。校方其後成立紀律調查委員會跟進，並重申對任何形式的不當行為採取零容忍態度。
主辦幹事會其後發表聲明致歉，承認現場管理不足，並表示尊重學生會按機制解散本屆幹事會的決定。校方強調會繼續按既定程序處理，並要求所有迎新活動遵守相關指引及培訓要求。
